import requests, time, numpy as np, pandas as pd, matplotlib.pyplot as plt
E="https://eutils.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/entrez/eutils/"
def get(u,p,t=120):
    for k in range(4):
        try:
            r=requests.get(u,params=p,timeout=t)
            if r.status_code==200: return r
        except Exception: pass
        time.sleep(0.8*(k+1))
    return None

rows=[l.split() for l in M.strip().split("\n")[1:]]
AA=[r[0] for r in rows]; idx={a:i for i,a in enumerate(AA)}
MM=np.array([[int(x) for x in r[1:]] for r in rows],np.int32)
def enc(s): return np.array([idx.get(c,idx["X"]) for c in s])
def nw(a,b,gap=10):
    A,Bv=enc(a),enc(b); n,m=len(A),len(Bv)
    S=MM[np.ix_(A,Bv)].astype(np.int32)
    H=np.zeros((n+1,m+1),np.int32); H[0,:]=-gap*np.arange(m+1); H[:,0]=-gap*np.arange(n+1)
    P=np.zeros((n+1,m+1),np.int8); P[0,1:]=3; P[1:,0]=2
    jg=(gap*np.arange(m+1)).astype(np.int32)
    for i in range(1,n+1):
        diag=H[i-1,0:m]+S[i-1,:]; up=H[i-1,1:m+1]-gap; best=np.maximum(diag,up)
        t=np.empty(m+1,np.int32); t[0]=H[i,0]; t[1:]=best+jg[1:]
        cur=np.maximum.accumulate(t)-jg; H[i,:]=cur
        pr=np.where(diag>=up,1,2).astype(np.int8); pr[cur[1:]>best]=3; P[i,1:]=pr
    i,j=n,m; mt=al=0
    while i>0 or j>0:
        p=P[i,j]
        if i>0 and j>0 and p==1: al+=1; mt+=(a[i-1]==b[j-1]); i-=1; j-=1
        elif (p==2 and i>0) or j==0: i-=1
        else: j-=1
    return 100*mt/al
